description: The provision path now routes every apt-get update through dply_apt_update (retry, then prune of unverifiable sources). Day-two scripts do not: DatabaseEngineInstallScripts, CacheServiceInstallScripts, HttpCacheDaemonInstallScripts, SnapshotBakeScript, webserver installers, edge proxy jobs, metrics, site fixers and certbot helpers all call apt-get update bare. Produce a complete inventory grouped by failure semantics (day-two job vs diagnostics vs operator command), then file child tickets. Output is the inventory plus tickets, not a blanket refactor.
title: Inventory bare apt-get update calls outside the provision preamble
